title: WITS Prettified (What Is This Structure Prettified)
description: Adds a better formatted /wits command to check the name of the structure you are at.
body: **____Incompatible with____ WITS____.____** Standalone command version of the better formatted version of /wits in the [Tangible Commands](https://modrinth.com/mod/tangible-commands) mod, which adds an item version of this command. __**Differences from WITS:**__ This mod adds a prettified version of the /wits version originally added by the [What Is This Structure](https://modrinth.com/mod/wits) mod with better formatting to be easier for players to read and cause less immersion breaking. This mod does not need WITS to be installed as it adds the command independently. The name of the structure still reflects the namespace of the structure, therefore it can still be reconstructed. ![With and Without](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66b1287ad538c47e46ccd222b16c464c8c915c40.png) __**Currently added commands:**__ * **/wits** * **/whatisthisstructure** * **/structurename** All of the commands above execute the same thing. They exist for intuitiveness. __**Support**__ [ReversTeam Discord Server](https://discord.com/invite/TJKZgr6UDg)   __**Credits**__ Credit to [What Is This Structure](https://modrinth.com/mod/wits) for implementing the original command. Their code is not reused in this mod.   Feel free to include in modpacks.
